in_marathi.name: Sharvikaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of beauty and strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvikaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvikaya is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharva' and 'Kaya'. Sharva means 'god of beauty, love, and joy'. Kaya means 'body' or 'form'. Thus, Sharvikaya can be interpreted as the 'Goddess of beautiful form' or the 'Goddess of divine beauty'.
